ours.title: The path
ours.text: Reel, then one comment keyword, then an auto-DM, then the paid report or reading. The reel gives the general reading, complete in itself. The paid product gives the personal one.

ours.title: Proof it works
ours.text: The New Year 2026 mulank series sold a yearly report at Rs 555 and made about Rs 1.5 lakh.

ours.title: Series, not single reels
ours.text: 10 to 20 episodes, one look, one story, one product at the end. Pilot first; batches of 3 to 5 after it passes.

ours.title: Every episode follows TAROT
list: Thehro (0-3 s): stop the scroll, open one question
Apni baat (3-10 s): the viewer finds themselves
Reveal (10-38 s): one idea, one usable thing
On to the next (38-41 s): name the next episode
Take the step (41-45 s): one keyword, and what they get

ours.title: Three gates before anything is shown as ready
list: Follow: will they come back and send it on?

ours.title: How we speak
list: Patterns and tendencies, never "this will happen"
No fear, no curse, no secrecy hooks
No promise on money, health or a person returning
Say when the reel simplifies the method

ours.title: Nobody approves their own work
ours.text: Every idea, script, look and film goes to an independent reviewer. Only the owner approves.

items.text: Reels that give a task and a time to come back are where the spikes come from.
A two-role skit with a named character is a steady, repeatable format.
One fixed hook line stays on screen for the whole reel, with captions on every spoken line.
The most-seen reel doubles as the sales page for a paid programme.
Topic alone (money) and a clock in the hook did not separate hits from ordinary reels.

scripts.title: 2027 driver series, episode 1
beats: Thehro
Two friends in one coach, both wearing a 5. The coach splits onto two tracks. Text: "Mulank same. Saal alag?"
Apni baat
"Aapka mulank + janm ka mahina + 2" on a lookup card.
Reveal
The engine cab; a saarthi steps out of the steam. "Hum ise aapke saal ka driver kehte hain." One friend's driver is 1, the other's is 7, and what that changes.
On to the next
"Kal: ek mulank, teen mahine, teen alag saal."
Take the step
"Comment DRIVER. DM mein aapka driver number aur 2027 report ki jaankari."

scripts.title: 2027 driver series, ten-episode outline
beats: Two friends with the same mulank split onto different tracks. The sum and the lookup grid.
One mulank, three birth months, three different years.
3 to 8
One theme each, all nine drivers inside: paisa, rishte, career, ghar, and two to decide. "Sehat" was flagged by a reviewer as a health-claim risk.
The same driver with mulank 1 and with mulank 7.
The report: what it gives, and the keyword.
